programme.title: Outline — Undergraduate Course Program of Computer Science | Kyoto University
programme.degree: Bachelor of Engineering, Faculty of Engineering, Undergraduate School of Informatics and Mathematical Science (情報学科), Computer Science Course (計算機科学コース), 4 years
programme.how_found: Course site www.s-im.t.kyoto-u.ac.jp/com/ (official-domain search result); international answers from the Kyoto iUP 'Application Guidelines for October 2027 Enrollment' PDF, which lists Informatics and Mathematical Science among the Faculty of Engineering departments open to iUP.
programme.notes: Kyoto iUP: 6-month preparatory course from October 2027, then the 4-year undergraduate course; the last two years 'taught mainly, or exclusively, in Japanese'. The answers below are for the Kyoto iUP route; the regular privately-financed international student selection (in Japanese, EJU-based) was not researched.

value.description: No minimum English score; typical scores of successful candidates: TOEFL iBT 4.5 (1-6) / 90 (0-120), IELTS 6.5. A test result or Form C (native speaker / English-medium education) is required.

english.quote: Although there is no specific minimum score for the English proficiency requirement, the following are typical scores of successful candidates
english.notes: Kyoto iUP October 2027 enrollment. 'No Japanese Language Proficiency Required' at application.

gpa.notes: Kyoto iUP: document review, then interview (in English); no grade threshold published. Faculty of Engineering applicants must submit score/grade reports for mathematics, physics and chemistry. No numeric minimum.

deadline.notes: Kyoto iUP, October 2027 enrollment (preparatory course; the undergraduate course follows). 5 p.m. JST. An eligibility screening for some applicants runs 'between July 1 and October 19, 2026'. Application fee JPY 9,800.

tuition.notes: Fee table in the October 2027 enrollment guidelines: undergraduate course admission fee JPY 282,000 (full waiver available), tuition JPY 535,800 annual ('Full or partial waivers available'); preparatory course JPY 296,000 for 6 months. The academic year of the figure is not printed (guidelines for the October 2027 intake); fees 'subject to change without prior notice'.

value.name: Kyoto iUP scholarships (admission fee and tuition fee waivers, preparatory-course monthly allowance)

scholarship_exists.quote: Scholarships that include full admission fee waivers and full or partial tuition fee waivers for four-and-a-half years are available for all Kyoto iUP students.
scholarship_exists.notes: Plus 'a monthly allowance of up to JPY 120,000 per month is provided to all Kyoto iUP students during the six-month preparatory course'; merit-based monthly allowances from supporting companies after enrolment. Tuition waiver may be full OR partial, so not confirmed as full tuition (FULL_TUITION not established). Housing: a room in a Kyoto University International House for the first 12 months (allocated, not stated as free).

scholarship_international.quote: Scholarships that include full admission fee waivers and full or partial tuition fee waivers for four-and-a-half years are available for all Kyoto iUP students.
scholarship_international.notes: Kyoto iUP is for non-Japanese citizens; every admitted iUP student gets the waivers. Admission to iUP is competitive (40 places).
